verificationPolicy: Source and automated checks are supplementary. A fully loaded deployed dev battle at portrait-mobile dimensions must prove turn progression, three-region layout, unclipped VFX and survivor-independent single/tri/all footprints before this batch is complete.

requirements.requirement: A raster VFX render or geometry failure cannot leave a player action awaiting forever; combat advances through one bounded timing gate.
requirements.remaining: On deployed dev, repeatedly cast Ice Arrow Rain and confirm damage settlement and the following turn continue without a frozen battle.

requirements.requirement: Portrait battle uses separate enemy, operation/status and ally regions; equal-type fixed slots and cards have equal dimensions, with enemies and allies visibly larger and no region intrusion.
requirements.remaining: Verify normal, BOSS, reinforcement and three-ally battles on deployed dev at multiple portrait-phone dimensions.

requirements.requirement: For all four elements, single VFX uses one-card geometry, tri VFX keeps a three-person footprint with one, two or three survivors, and all-target VFX always covers the complete fixed-side battlefield region.
requirements.remaining: Capture representative fire, water, wind and earth single/tri/all casts on deployed dev, including Ice Arrow Rain after enemy deaths.

requirements.requirement: Battle VFX is not clipped by unit, slot or battle-region containers; single attacks remain centered on the actual card and range geometry is derived from live Fixed Slot/card bounding boxes rather than hard-coded coordinates.
requirements.remaining: Inspect deployed dev VFX bounds and centers during real portrait-mobile combat.

requirements.requirement: Wind Flame uses one shared range raster node and stale V143 stages are removed before the next cast so overlapping sheets cannot appear as two simultaneous videos.
requirements.remaining: Cast Wind Flame repeatedly on deployed dev and confirm only one visible raster stage/node per cast.

blockers: The candidate has not yet completed Repository checks and has not been merged/deployed to dev.
Fully loaded deployed-dev portrait combat verification is still required.
